messages:
Maria (PM): Quick sync — I want a short rollout checklist for the new "analytics sidecar" in Console. It's the slim panel that follows a route and shows per-model metrics + quick filters. We need to decide scope, quota behavior, and saved-query UX.
Jon (Eng): +1. Can we define expected API changes first? savedQuery scope needs to include sidecar vs full-view.
Sameer (Platform): Do we treat sidecar fetches as separate telemetry (lower sample rate) or reuse route telemetry? quota math matters.
Elena (Design): Sidecar should feel ephemeral — default to session-only unless user explicitly pins. Pin action should surface ownership and quota impact.
Tasha (Analytics): Important: sampling for sidecar = 1% by default, but when user pins we bump to their sampling for that saved query. Otherwise cost explodes.
Maria (PM): Thinking checklist items: API contract, sampling/quotas, pinning/persistence UX, fallback when model not served, rollout gating and telemetry for the rollout itself. Anyone want to draft?
Jon (Eng): I can draft API shape. Proposal: savedQuery.scope = { "type": "route|model|sidecar", "route_id": "...", "model_id": "...", "pinned": true|false }
Jon (Eng): Example payload: 
```json
{
  "name": "slow-llm-route",
  "query": "status:500",
  "scope": {"type":"sidecar","route_id":"r_12345","model_id":"m_gptx-small"},
  "pinned": false
}
```
Maria (PM): Good. We should call out that sidecar scope inherits route-level RBAC but not team-level shared folders by default. Pinning can create copies for sharing.
Sameer (Platform): About quotas: sidecar reads should be charged from route-preview pool on hosted. For Dedicated/Private we default to tenant-managed sample budget. We need a fallback policy: if route-preview budget exhausted, show sampled metrics with a clear CTA to request more.
Elena (Design): UI: show small badge: "sampled" with tooltip: "This view is sampled at 1% — pin to persist full sampling". Also show estimated token cost when pinning.
Tasha (Analytics): We should emit an event for each pin/unpin: analytics.sidecar.pin with {user,route,model,sample_rate,prev_state}. We'll use that to measure conversion -> full saves.
Jon (Eng): Implementation notes: sidecar route requests should call the same route telemetry API but with header `X-Console-Sidecar: 1` to let backend apply sample-rate overrides. Also cache keys need to include sidecar:true to avoid polluting route dashboards.
Jon (Eng): Pseudo-config: 
```yaml
sidecar: 
  default_sample: 0.01
  pin_sample: 1.0
  rate_limit_group: console-sidecar
```
Sameer (Platform): Important: rate_limit_group ties into existing quota service. We'll create a soft-fallback that returns a 200 with partial data + header `X-Console-Fallback: sampled` — Console should show warning not an error.
Maria (PM): Rollout gating: start internal -> beta tenants -> 10% of traffic -> full. For each stage we check pin conversion and error rate. Stop if error rate increases > 0.5% over baseline.
Elena (Design): Add two small UX experiments: A) Pin CTA inline vs B) top-of-panel nudge. We'll measure pin rate and confusion.
Tasha (Analytics): For telemetry gating we need a dashboard tile: "Sidecar rollout — sample rate, pin conversions, quota hits, fallback rate". I can make the dashboard if API events are stable.
Jon (Eng): API change needs a migration path: older saved queries without scope should continue to map to route-level full views. New clients can use `scope.type = sidecar`. Backward compatible.
Sameer (Platform): Security: sidecar read respects route ACLs. But pin-to-share should go through saved-query ACL flow and require explicit grant. Add a logs/audit entry when a pin creates a persistent saved-query.
Maria (PM): Action items: Jon draft PR for API + header behavior. Sameer add rate_limit_group and soft-fallback. Elena design pin UI + sampled badge. Tasha create rollout dashboard and events list. I'll coordinate beta tenants and messaging.
Jon (Eng): I'll open PR with API docs and unit tests. Quick question: do we allow sidecar to trigger model-level compare (compare multiple model columns)?
Elena (Design): We can show one model primary; compare UI should be an opt-in expand action that triggers higher sample rate. Tooltip says "compare will increase sample to 100% for this user session".
Sameer (Platform): Devops note: add a feature flag `console.analytics.sidecar` for staged rollout. deploy-bot: deploy scheduled for canary at 2024-03-12 18:00 UTC. :rocket:
Maria (PM): Nice. Let's keep the first rollout read-only (no pin persists) until analytics events look good. Tentative timeline: design+api PRs this week, internal beta next week.
Tasha (Analytics): I'll instrument events and share dashboard link once PR landed.
Jon (Eng): quick follow-up: include a small opt-out for users worried about data capture (privacy). We'll honor console-level preference.
Maria (PM): Great call. Ok signoffs? :thumbsup:
Elena (Design): :thumbsup:
Sameer (Platform): :thumbsup:
Tasha (Analytics): :thumbsup:
Jon (Eng): :thumbsup:
Maria (PM): I'll convert this to a tracked checklist and ping infra for the feature flag. Thanks all.
